caption:
A US judge has officially dismissed the lawsuit filed by Donald Trump against The Wall Street Journal.

The legal action stemmed from a report alleging that the former president had sent a birthday card to Jeffrey Epstein.

By dismissing the case, the court has brought this specific legal chapter to an end.

We tracked this story across three independent sources to ensure accuracy. Do you think public figures should use the courts to settle disputes with journalists?
